summary: Iteration 22 — PDF Attachment Parsing (CAS/bank statements) for Gmail. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed on public URL including all critical paths — /api/gmail/emails returns attachments[] (each with attachment_id/filename/size/looks_like_cas bool); /api/gmail/parse-attachment validates (400 for missing email_id/attachment_id, 401/403 for no auth); encrypted PDF (Zerodha Capital Gain email 19d96681abe47ab8) returns 200 with {success:false, password_required:true, message contains 'PAN'}; wrong password returns 401 with 'Incorrect PDF password'; unencrypted PDF (Zerodha Daily Margin 19d97c3a7e1c7490) returns 200 with {success:true, data:{document_type, totals, mutual_funds[], equity_holdings[], transactions[]}, applied:true, applied_fields[], transactions_saved}. Source regression: services/gmail_auto_scan.py FINANCIAL_SEARCH_QUERY contains CAS/consolidated/cams.com/nsdl.co.in and newer_than:365d. Regression endpoints /api/gmail/scan-and-apply-all, /api/documents/auto-apply, /api/reports/peer-comparison all unchanged and working. Frontend: /arthvyay/smart-import Gmail Connect tab renders properly — shows connected account, 'Scan Financial Emails' button triggers fetch, 5 financial emails listed with expand chevrons. Verified in source: parse-attachment-btn-N, cas-password-modal, cas-password-input, cas-password-submit, cas-password-cancel data-testids all present in SmartImport.js (L519-908); CAS password modal has purple gradient header, 3-tip info, PAN message. handleParseAttachment wiring matches backend contract. Did not drive end-to-end Playwright click through parse button due to email-row data-testid variance + time, but code path is verified and backend E2E with real encrypted+unencrypted PDFs passed.
action_items: (Nice-to-have) Email list rows in SmartImport.js don't use a predictable data-testid like gmail-email-{idx}; consider adding one so Playwright tests can reliably expand each email to reveal attachments.
(Nice-to-have) pdf_attachment_parser.parse_cas_pdf truncates pdf_text to 80000 chars — for very large CAS (>80 pages), add a second-pass or warn in response.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/gmail.py parse-attachment (L386-397): parsed_cas_statements collection write happens even when auto_apply=False is not the case — fine, but no index on user_id. Add an index if this collection grows.

services/pdf_attachment_parser.py extract_pdf_text (L38-40): if pypdf.errors.PdfReadError is caught, it falls through to pdfplumber but for encrypted PDFs without password pdfplumber will also fail and raise — the path is covered by the outer try/except but the (was_encrypted=True, text='') branch only fires on successful probe. Consider explicit probing via pypdf first, then branching — already done correctly in the happy path.

routes/gmail.py parse-attachment: does not limit PDF size before downloading/parsing — a 50MB attachment will consume memory and GPT tokens. Add a size check against att['size'] or pdf_bytes length (e.g., 15MB cap) and return 413.
routes/gmail.py /emails (L212-215): Gmail query is inline and duplicated vs services/gmail_auto_scan.FINANCIAL_SEARCH_QUERY. Extract to one shared constant to avoid drift.

success_rate.frontend: 80% — Gmail tab + scan + email list rendered, full E2E click-through of parse-attachment-btn not driven by Playwright; all data-testids verified in source and backend E2E of both unencrypted/encrypted PDFs passed on live Gmail
